items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Well, no, I didn't know none of whom they were... Louis Prima. Did you ever go to Chicago and hear many bands there?

ctx.x: I just wondered if you remember any of the guys' names.

Well, no, I didn't know none of whom they were. But once, in 51, I believe, the time when Lewis and the other Lewis was playing, one was playing 48 and by the way, the other was playing 49. Lewis, what's his name? Italian boy, what's his name? Lewis, Lewis. Prima? Yeah. They both was playing on Broadway the same time. Oh, wow. Mm-hmm. Louis Prima. Did you ever go to Chicago and hear many bands there?
Well, with my homeboys, I went to the Riggle Theater twice once out there.
